title: Perbahasan Kompleks
canDo: Debate an abstract or ethical issue with nuance
Synthesise multiple viewpoints into a conclusion
lifeBenefit: Hold your own in complex, high-level discussions on social or ethical issues.

vocab.example: Ini satu dilema etika yang rumit.
vocab.exampleEn: This is a complicated ethical dilemma.

vocab.example: Tidak dapat dinafikan bahawa isu ini kompleks.
vocab.exampleEn: It cannot be denied that this issue is complex.

vocab.ms: di satu pihak... di pihak lain
vocab.en: on one hand... on the other hand
vocab.example: Di satu pihak, ia membantu; di pihak lain, ada risiko.
vocab.exampleEn: On one hand, it helps; on the other hand, there's risk.

vocab.example: Kita tidak boleh mengetepikan pandangan ini.
Mari kita mensintesiskan kedua-dua pandangan ini.
vocab.exampleEn: Let's synthesise both of these viewpoints.

vocab.example: Kita perlu lihat isu ini secara holistik.
vocab.exampleEn: We need to look at this issue holistically.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'It cannot be denied that this is a complicated ethical dilemma.'
practiceExercises.answer: Tidak dapat dinafikan bahawa ini satu dilema etika yang rumit.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'On one hand it helps the economy; on the other hand, we cannot dismiss the environmental cost.'
practiceExercises.answer: Di satu pihak ia membantu ekonomi; di pihak lain, kita tidak boleh mengetepikan kos alam sekitar.

scenario.setting: A nuanced debate on an ethical issue in technology (AI and jobs)

script.ms: Tidak dapat dinafikan bahawa automasi mencipta dilema etika yang rumit.
script.en: It cannot be denied that automation creates a complicated ethical dilemma.

script.ms: Setuju. Di satu pihak, ia meningkatkan produktiviti; di pihak lain, ramai kehilangan pekerjaan.
script.en: Agreed. On one hand, it increases productivity; on the other hand, many lose jobs.

script.ms: Kita tidak boleh mengetepikan kesan sosial jangka panjang.
script.en: We cannot dismiss the long-term social impact.

script.ms: Betul. Mari kita cuba mensintesiskan — mungkin latihan semula ialah jalan tengah.
script.en: Right. Let's try to synthesise — perhaps retraining is the middle path.

script.ms: Secara holistik, itu penyelesaian yang lebih seimbang.
script.en: Holistically, that's a more balanced solution.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are an articulate debate partner discussing the ethics of automation and job loss. Use sophisticated discourse markers and be willing to synthesise a nuanced middle position with the learner. High-register, thoughtful tone.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the ethics-debate dialogue, focusing on sophisticated discourse markers and measured pacing.
Debate an abstract ethical issue of your choice with the AI partner persona, using 'di satu pihak... di pihak lain' at least once.
rubric: presents both sides of an issue

speakingPrompts.instructions: Deliver a 3-minute nuanced argument on a complex issue that acknowledges at least one strong counterpoint before concluding.

questions.prompt: Translate: 'We need to look at this holistically.'
questions.answer: Kita perlu lihat ini secara holistik.
